edges.reason: msg.sender is used to verify and decrement allowance inside transferFrom
msg.sender is compared to owner to gate the delegate function
msg.sender is compared to owner to gate the list function
owner is assigned from tx.origin in the constructor, creating tx.origin authorization
block.timestamp is used to build the router deadline parameter
checkBots performs an external call to stopTheBots before the function body executes
the checkBots modifier runs its external call before transferFrom updates balances, enabling reentrancy
delegate executes arbitrary code at a caller-supplied address via delegatecall
list performs an external call to the Uniswap router addLiquidityETH
allowance subtraction in transferFrom is unchecked (no SafeMath, pragma 0.7)
balance subtraction in transferFrom is unchecked (no SafeMath, pragma 0.7)
totalSupply multiply/divide in list is unchecked arithmetic
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom
constructor calls pairOfTokens to compute uniPair
stopTheBots is the external target invoked by the checkBots modifier
uniPair is passed as an argument to the bot protection external call
balanceOf mapping is read and written in transferFrom
allowance mapping is read and written in transferFrom
routerForPancake is the router used by the external addLiquidityETH call
totalSupply participates in unchecked accounting inside list
owner is the required sender for delegate
owner is the required sender for list
wETH is used by the constructor when computing the pair address
_from parameter flows into transferFrom balance and allowance logic
_to parameter flows into transferFrom balance credit logic
_value parameter flows into unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic
_spender parameter is written into the allowance mapping by approve
_value parameter is written into the allowance mapping by approve
parameter a is the delegatecall target in delegate
parameter b is the delegatecall calldata in delegate
_numList parameter feeds balance and liquidity arithmetic in list
_toWho parameter is iterated to assign balances in list
_amounts parameter supplies the balances assigned in list
notABot result of the external call is required before the modifier body runs
isNotBot return bytes of the external call are captured in checkBots
pair local variable is returned by pairOfTokens

_to is solely a parameter of transferFrom and carries no independent semantics

_numList is solely a parameter of list
